depth_justification: The copilot exhibits mode collapse: it repeats the identical templated question ('The fine-tuned LLM (Mistral-7B) is doing what? ... crisis-keyword detector ... interaction with the mood-logging') verbatim across six+ turns, never engaging with the developer's concrete disclosures (10k synthetic GPT-4 dialogues, F1=0.74 detector, 'wellness app' classification dodge, no contraindication screening). The final report invents wrong dimension IDs and even renames the product 'SeraphimBot', so nothing is laser-focused on THIS app.
actionability_justification: Mitigations are vague platitudes with no implementable recipe: 'Bring a clinical psychologist on board', 'Do a conformity assessment under the EU AI Act', 'Implement contraindication screening at onboarding' — no specific GDPR/AI-Act articles, UI patterns, or screening instruments. The report is internally broken, listing the same dimensions as both covered and 'not covered'.
salient_examples: The fine-tuned LLM (Mistral-7B) is doing what? Is it delivering clinical CBT exercises, or is it making clinical judgments? ... (This is [P2.D3] — the clinical judgment risk; [P2.D5] — the crisis-keyword detector and its interaction with the logging and adaptation.)
